selection: Physical roles plus unsupervised shared-training redundancy diagnostics; no predictive target or validation/test score used.

roles.VHM0: Current total sea-state height; legitimate persistence information.
roles.VHM0_SW1: One dominant-swell height; retained for physical partition information despite high correlation with total height.
roles.VHM0_WW: Wind-sea height distinguishes local forcing from swell.
roles.VTM02: Current mean wave period; representative spectral period.
roles.VTPK: Peak period complements the mean-period measure.
roles.eastward_wind: Signed eastward forcing and wind orientation.
roles.northward_wind: Signed northward forcing and wind orientation.
roles.wind_speed: Current forcing magnitude; nonlinear magnitude is useful even with signed components.
roles.VMDR_sin: Total wave direction without a discontinuity at north.
roles.VMDR_cos: Paired circular encoding needed to represent wave direction.
roles.VHM0_lag_24h: Longer daily sea-state history without all intermediate lags.
roles.VHM0_change_3h: Recent trend; also encodes the omitted three-hour lag.
roles.VHM0_roll_mean_12h: One trailing mean summarizing recent sea-state level.
roles.VHM0_roll_std_12h: Trailing variability rather than another height-level summary.
roles.month_sin: Seasonal phase representing monsoon-related annual variation.
roles.month_cos: Companion seasonal encoding avoids a year-end discontinuity.
